about.definition: Paint by numbers na way to bring one picture back: you divide am into flat regions, number every region, and give every number one color from palette wey no dey change. Paint every region with im own number color and the picture go join back.
about.generatorDefinition: Paint by numbers generator dey do the dividing for you. E go reduce your photo to small palette, join the pixels wey dey near each other and get the same color into regions, trace the outline of dem regions, and put the color number inside each one.
about.factPriceValue: Free. No account, no watermark, no trial, no limit for how you use am.
about.factColorsValue: 3–100 for automatic palette, 12 real paint set from 8 to 150 colors, or your own color list for any size.
about.factPaperValue: A4, A3, A2, A1, A0, US Letter, and US Tabloid — as one sheet, or shared across small sheets.
about.factExportsValue: Real vector SVG, laser-ready SVG wey get cut line and engrave line for separate layers, PDF wey you fit print, and PNG.
about.factRegionsValue: After you generate, you fit join two regions wey dey near each other by hand, or split one region — no be just one general detail slider.
about.factProcessingValue: Everything dey happen for your browser. Dem dey read your photo from your device and e no dey ever go any server.
